address: 598 Mingshui Road, Zhongshan District, Taipei, Taiwan
bio: In contrast with the austere façade, the plush interior is adorned with warm wood and colourful art by local artists. Chef Jim Yang has been cooking Hangzhou and Jiangzhe fare for over 30 years. In his 10-course set menu, he tells his life story with home-style recipes reinvented using European techniques. Expect ingredients that are less common in Chinese cuisine (e.g. saffron, cheese and Japanese seaweed). The tea pairings bring out the best in the food.
